name: Carousel post
summary: A single post that holds several images or clips that the viewer swipes through.
how: Group 6 to 20 media items in one post.
Show a dot pager and a count badge.
Open with the best item and end with a light one.
Let each item keep its own crop.

origin.note: Instagram lets users share up to 10 photos and videos in one post.

adoptions.via: Users post casual camera-roll carousels that they call photo dumps.
